body: Owner approved retiring the legacy single-file ticket backend (revised scope, owner-approved). Remove the legacy WRITE paths so the directory store (.adlc/tickets/) is the only backend agb writes: lib/adlc-bridge.mjs (drop the legacy write branch and the both-stores delete in writeAdlcTickets), lib/worktrees.mjs and lib/scheduler.mjs (drop tickets.json from ignore/exclude/discard lists), lib/plan.mjs, lib/preflight.mjs, lib/doctor.mjs, lib/active-rails.mjs. A repo that still has a legacy .adlc/tickets.json (alone or beside the directory store, including a symlink or dangling symlink) must NEVER be silently ignored or deleted: add assertNoLegacyTicketStore(repo) in lib/adlc-bridge.mjs throwing code LEGACY_TICKET_STORE with an actionable message naming `adlc ticket store migrate`; call it from writeAdlcTickets, from the start of compilePlan (outside the best-effort try/catch, so plan fails instead of warning) and from the run preflight in lib/scheduler.mjs before any mutation; doctor Ticket Store reports fail for legacy and both. KEEP defensive read-side symlink checks of .adlc/tickets.json in lib/active-rails.mjs and lib/doctor.mjs (fail-closed safety). DO NOT touch hooks/policy/constants.mjs (IMPLICIT_RAIL_FILES) or scripts/rails-guard-ci.mjs (CI trust root denying reintroduced legacy files). lib/migrate.mjs is `agb migrate` (install migration) and has no ticket-store code; leave it. Update test/fixtures/fake-adlc and affected tests; add tests that a legacy-only repo and a both-stores repo produce the LEGACY_TICKET_STORE error from writeAdlcTickets, compilePlan and run, and that nothing is written or deleted. Amend the AGENTS.md sentence saying the single-file backend is still recognized in unmigrated target repos (owner-approved doctrine amendment), add a CHANGELOG.md breaking-change entry, and update the website pages that mention tickets.json (internals/plan-compiler, internals/policy-guard, project/adlc-in-this-repo, reference/file-layout, getting-started/verify incl. the Model catalog doctor row, concepts/rail-enforcement, concepts/plan-boundary). Acceptance: no code path in lib writes or deletes .adlc/tickets.json (remaining mentions are the LEGACY error, read-side symlink checks, and comments); legacy detection fails closed with the migrate message; npm test green.
title: Retire the legacy single-file .adlc/tickets.json backend (owner-approved)
